en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an Italian city square and adjoining street. The scene shows historic multi‑story buildings with arcades, frescoed facades, wooden shutters, and a distinctive domed corner roof. A decorative cast‑iron streetlamp stands in the foreground. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the square. The caption at the top reads "Trento – Piazza del Duomo e via Larga," indicating this is the cathedral square and Via Larga in Trento.
